notes.title: 1/19 Update - Fixes & Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We hope you are all enjoying the game. We've just rolled out a new patch, which features a lot of tweaks, improvements, and small fixed to various things in the game; you can read a full list of changes below.

[list]
[*] Gallery Feature Added 
[*] The "H" key can now be used to hide the text box 
[*] Improvements to English translation - typo fixes & various language improvements
[*] Restored missing text strings in certain scenes
[*] Fixed certain UI buttons using wrong language counterparts
[*] Small quality and engine improvements and fixes
[/list]

That's all for now! Thank you to everyone who supported the game and continues to do so - we all really appreciate it!
